name: Improved Focused Dispelling
body:
You can draw upon your own mystical skills and talent to disperse spells and magical effects.

Prerequisite: Ability to cast greater dispel magic

Benefit: Once per day, you may reroll a dispel check. You must decide to use this ability before the results are revealed. You must take the second roll, even if it is worse.
